changed_boundary: Only lock acquisition, retained ownership witness, initial lease publication, and terminal cleanup ordering change.
collision_rule: An O_EXCL collision closes local descriptors and returns failure; it never unlinks, truncates, parses, or replaces the existing path.
cleanup_rule: Lease cleanup requires the exact owner record while the random-token lock remains owned; lock cleanup requires the retained descriptor, directory, device, inode, single link, and complete payload.
partial_failure_rule: Any ambiguous failure after initial lease publication remains occupied for terminal audit.
migration_rule: This separate module cannot replace tools/managed_exclusive_lease.py or any future source lock until the live qm8 process terminalizes and local controls plus independent proof pass.
